evidence.reason: The code builds `reviewed` as a set of fingerprints only, discarding each review's `baseSha`/`headSha`, then treats any fingerprint present in any covered review as satisfying the lineage check for every later `fixed` disposition. This contradicts the stated requirement at lines 218-221 that a re-fix be a harm candidate only when a covered review observed the finding at the re-fix's range. An unrelated covered review at a different head can therefore make a re-fix count as a candidate at line 250.
